lines.t: Shadows creep across the ancient hills
Coalitions whisper in the midnight chill
Hearts turn to stone
Eyes blind with pride
They march in thunder
Swords at their side
Promises of glory
Maps redrawn in fire
They think the mountains
Mountains will bow to their desires
Rise up, rise up
Come storm the gate
Gather your legions
Seal your fate
Like clouds of fury rolling in the sky
Challenge the one who never dies
But the fire will answer, the earth will collide
Your mighty towers in pieces break
Rise up to fall
Rise up to fall
Jerusalem weeps beneath a heavy load
A burden caught in prophecy of old
Nations rage in blood to tear it down
But the hand unseen wears victory's crown
Winds of wrath blow through the battle line
Brother turns on brother in the sound
In the blaze of jealousy the heavens roar
Sigh through the wheat, they stand no more
Stubble burns bright in the open field
A spectacle made, the proud revealed
From the throne comes the voice that shatters all
The shield of the faithful will never fall
Rise up, rise up, come storm the gates
Gather your legions, seal your fate
Like clouds of fury rolling in the sky
Challenge the one who never dies
But the fire will answer, the earth will quake
Your mighty towers in pieces break
Rise up to fall
Rise up to fall
In the latter days the promise stands
The Holy One stretches out His hands
Not for their merit, but for His name
He guards the remnant through the flame
Rise up to fall
Rise up to fall
Rise up to fight
Rise up to fight
Thank you.
